summary: Frontend-only test of (1) 'Extras' folders at any depth treated as one 'Extras' part section of the show/movie and (2) the auto multi-part check after Update Library. Used the simulated electronAPI harness with TMDB mocked via ctx.route. All requested scenarios pass except one auto-match interaction bug (the primary card flips when the existing show card has no overview). Also found 2 edge cases from the new 'Extras anywhere' rule and 1 related older TV-first issue.

ui_bugs.issue: EXTRAS_DIR matches any folder segment at depth >= 2 whose name ENDS with an extras word, so real titles are swallowed. (a) The TV show 'Extras' (D:\TV\Extras\Season 1\Extras.S01E01.mkv, S01E02, Season 2\S02E01) is not grouped (no Multi-Part button). Its files are treated as extras of D:\TV, and the TV Shows count is 0 even with S01E01 names. (b) D:\Movies\The Interview\The Interview Part 1/Part 2.mkv: the regex matches 'The Interview' (ends with ' Interview'), so rule 2 skips them and no group is suggested.

The main movie file is shown under a 'Parts' section labelled 'Part 1', and the card shows 'Get series & episode info'. Cosmetic: label it 'Movie'/'Main feature' and hide the series button for movieExtras cards.

integration_issues.issue: Setup: an existing show card Batman has media_type tv, tmdb_id 5 and poster_path but NO overview. Update Library adds Season 2\Batman.S02E01.mkv and Extras\Bloopers.mkv, and auto-match matches both as MOVIES (search/movie 'Batman S02E01' -> movie 7074 with an overview). If the user merges after auto-match finishes, mergeIntoOne scores n1 at 7 and the show at 6, so n1 becomes primary. Result: the merged card id is n1, media_type 'movie', tmdb_id 7074, the movie poster, the show's tmdb_id 5 is lost, and no episode info is fetched for S02E01. When the show card has an overview (tie, stable order) the result is correct: bat keeps tmdb 5/tv/poster, 4 parts, and /tv/5/season/1 and /season/2 are requested.

integration_issues.flow: Fetch Posters / auto-match on movie+extras cards
integration_issues.issue: fetchFullMetadata uses preferTv: isMultiPart(movie). A movie card that is multi-part only because of Extras (Heat + Extras) searches /search/tv FIRST ('/3/search/tv?query=Heat' seen). Any TV series with the same name could then be matched as a TV show. Deep Extras now make many more movie cards multi-part, so the impact grows.

verified_passing: Extras at any depth: 7 separate Batman cards -> Multi-Part (1). Exactly one group 'Batman', '7 files · whole show': Season 1 x2, then Extras: Gag Reel, Part 1, Part 2, Batman.S01E01.Commentary, Promo. No separate Interviews group.
Merge -> 1 card (id b1). Sections parts-section-season-1 (2: S01E01, S01E02) and parts-section-extras (5, all labelled 'Extra'). The Commentary file is NOT an episode.

Series info: calls were exactly /search/tv, /tv/5, /tv/5/season/1, with no extras season request. Toast: '2 of 7 parts matched'. TV Shows count went 2 -> 1 after the merge and stayed 1 after series info.

Auto check (auto off): Update Library -> toast 'Library updated: 2 added' and the dialog pops up by itself, heading 'New files belong with existing titles'. Only the Batman group is listed (Season 1: Batman (2 parts), Season 2: S02E01, Extras: Bloopers). Merge -> one card 'bat' with 4 parts, tmdb_id 5, media_type tv, poster kept. Calls /tv/5/season/1 + /season/2 gave S2E1 episode info. Card count 2 (Batman + Heat), TV count 1.
Unrelated new movie (Alien) -> no auto dialog.

Escape closes the auto dialog without merging (n1/n2 stay separate). Multi-Part (1) still offers it with the regular heading, and Close works. After a reload there is no auto popup and the button is still shown.
'Not multi-part' in the auto dialog closes it. dismissed key = ['show|d:\\tv\\batman (1966)'], and the button stays hidden after reload.

Merge DURING an in-flight auto-match (3s TMDB delay): the final card is bat with tmdb 5/tv, 4 parts and S2E1 info. Removed n1/n2 are not resurrected, the result persists after reload, and the queue is [].

Regression: Green Planet Part 1..3 (flat) is grouped and labelled Part 1..3. Heat (1995) + Extras\Trailer + Extras\Interviews\Mann Part 1/2 form one 'movie + extras' group (4 files), and the Mann parts are not grouped separately. Multi-Part (2) merges both. Fetch Posters (3) finished with the 'Done!' toast. TV Shows filter works. No page errors.
action_items: MEDIUM: In mergeIntoOne (or in mergeGroups for auto groups), prefer the existing card: media_type 'tv' / an already multi-part card / the oldest added_at should beat an auto-matched single new file. Alternatively skip TMDB auto-match for new files that land in an autoMulti group with an existing matched card (and for files inside Extras folders). Otherwise new episodes/extras get matched as random movies (e.g. 'Bloopers').

MEDIUM: Anchor EXTRAS_DIR to the whole segment (^(extras?|bonus...|interviews?|trailers?|...)$) so that 'The Interview' is not matched. Do not treat a segment as Extras when its parent is the library root (D:\TV\Extras\Season 1\Extras.S01E01 is the show 'Extras').
LOW: preferTv should use the number of non-Extras parts (> 1) or isSeries, not isMultiPart, so movie+extras cards search movie first. Hide 'Get series & episode info' for movie+extras cards.
LOW: Series toast '2 of 7 parts matched' counts extras in the total. Consider '2 of 2 episodes'.
critical_code_review_comments: mergeGroups post-merge attachEpisodes overwrites parts with r.parts. If a season request fails (tmdbGet returns null), the existing episode info of already-matched parts is wiped, because attachEpisodes returns clean parts. Keep the old p.episode when the season fetch fails.

The autoMulti effect clears autoMultiIdsRef on the first multipartGroups change after queueAutoMatch. It works because setMovies and queueAutoMatch are batched together, but it is fragile if a future caller queues before setMovies.
Auto-match still spends TMDB calls (search + details) on cards that were merged away mid-flight, and the toast 'New titles matched: 2 of 2' shows even though those cards no longer exist.
LocalLibraryPage.jsx is ~3140 lines; consider extracting the auto-match/auto-multipart hooks.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use g={'page':page}; exec(open('/app/tests/test_auto_multipart_ui.py').read(), g) inside browser_automation. It provides batman_lib(overview), NEW, UNRELATED, base_scan, open_ctx(lib, scan, auto, delay) and summarize. X.TmdbMock handles search/movie, search/tv (batman -> 5) and /tv/{id}/season/N (3 episodes). Cards have no movie-card testid: use 'div.cursor-pointer.overflow-hidden'. The D1 bug reproduces with batman_lib(None) + auto='on': wait for the 'New titles matched' toast, then merge.
